name: rounce
description: Puts the work queue in front of your agents instead of hoping they ask for it. Registers rounce's ten MCP tools, and a SessionStart hook injects the ranked ready queue into context before the agent reads your first message — so it starts every session already knowing what is workable, what is blocked, and what is parked, without an instruction it can ignore. Adds /rounce:ready, /rounce:board, and /rounce:file. Silent in repositories that have no store, so it costs nothing where it is not used. Claude Code gets enforcement via the hook; Codex gets the same tools plus an AGENTS.md snippet, because as of codex-cli 0.146 it offers no way to grant hook trust — that asymmetry is real and documented rather than papered over.
